theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_gradient_ae_eq_of_contDiffAt
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (w u : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient w g (ball 0 1) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 u x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), u x = w x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)), gradient u x = g x
